name: zquorum
title: zQuorum · anonymous quorums in Cairo, on Starknet
description: A group reaches a quorum without revealing who voted. Members register Pedersen commitments; a vote reveals only a nullifier — unlinkable to any member without their secret, and a repeated nullifier is a rejected double vote. All cryptography (commit, nullifier, set root, vote check) runs as a Cairo 2 program in circuit/ so the anchor never reimplements a hash, and the statement is already prover-shaped for the v0.2 STARK upgrade. The books (member commitments, spent nullifiers, tally, frozen root) can live on the ZQuorum Starknet contract (contract/), which recomputes the root with the same zq code and enforces the freeze, one vote per nullifier and the threshold on-chain. A static Next.js console (app/) is served by the Python-stdlib anchor (server.py) next to the JSON API, behind the mod-protocol gateway.

protocol.scheme: commit/nullifier (Semaphore-style), Pedersen over the STARK field
protocol.root: fold pedersen('zq-root', ...) over the sorted commitment set
protocol.freeze: the member set freezes at the first vote
protocol.circuit: src/circuit/ (Cairo package zq); run via scarb cairo-run, tested via scarb cairo-test
protocol.trust_v0_1: anchor = trusted tallier; sees a secret transiently during verification, persists only (nullifier, choice)
protocol.upgrade_v0_2: STARK-prove the same circuit so votes verify without the tallier seeing secrets; commit/nullifier derivation moves client-side
protocol.contract: src/contract/ (Scarb package zquorum, path-depends on circuit/ zq): ZQuorum keeps commitments, nullifiers, tally and the zq::root of the sorted set at freeze; tallier-only writes; snforge tests
protocol.onchain_trust: the tallier attests membership (it ran the circuit); the contract enforces everything else publicly. Every tx is sent by the tallier account, so the sender never identifies a voter

state: data/quorums.json (ledger), data/deployments.json, data/devnet/ (chain state + tallier account, 0600) — all gitignored. Secrets are never stored anywhere.

endpoints.POST /zquorum/api/commit: Derive a commitment from a secret (secret=)
endpoints.POST /zquorum/api/create: Open a quorum (name=, threshold=, desc=, network=devnet|sepolia|mainnet to keep the books on Starknet)
endpoints.POST /zquorum/api/vote: Cast an anonymous vote (name=, secret=, choice=yes|no)
endpoints.POST /zquorum/api/anchor: Put an existing quorum on the ZQuorum contract and replay its members + votes (name=, network=)
endpoints.GET /zquorum/api/onchain?name=: Read the quorum's books off Starknet and diff them against the ledger (match, diff)
endpoints.GET /zquorum/api/chain?network=: Devnet liveness, the deployment, quorums on-chain
endpoints.POST /zquorum/api/deploy: Declare + deploy ZQuorum (network=, account=) — loopback only
endpoints.POST /zquorum/api/devnet: start|stop|reset|status the local devnet (action=) — loopback only
endpoints.note: The app self-calls the same handlers under /zquorum/_api/* (gateway keeps the prefix); /api/zquorum/* is the permanent legacy alias.
endpoints.GET /zquorum/api/boot: Auto-run status: circuit compiled, devnet up, ZQuorum deployed, console built (runs on every server start)

safety: Devnet by default: no real funds. Secrets are verified by executing the Cairo circuit and are never persisted; the ledger and the contract store commitments, nullifiers and choices only. deploy/devnet and anchoring on sepolia/mainnet are loopback-only. route=true links the module onto the gateway at {host}/zquorum (app) and {host}/zquorum/api (API).

networks.devnet: local starknet-devnet on :51302 (seed 0, account 0 = tallier); started on demand, state dumped to data/devnet/
networks.sepolia: m zquorum/deploy network=sepolia account=<sncast account funded with STRK>
networks.mainnet: m zquorum/deploy network=mainnet account=<sncast account funded with STRK>

autorun: server.py runs boot() on start (circuit build if stale, devnet :51302, ZQuorum deploy on devnet, console build if dist/ missing); pm2 'zquorum' -> src/server.py (autorestart, saved in the pm2 dump that pm2-root restores on reboot)
layout: src/ = code (mod.py, server.py, build.sh, app/, circuit/, contract/, tests/); root = config.json, README.md, data/
